title: Ligand-field regulation enables high energy-efficiency cathodes for aqueous zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1319-1330
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07175E, Paper
Quan Zong, Xuelian Liu, Keyi Chen, Qilong Zhang, Haoran Yuan, Shuang Zhou, Gongxun Bai, Guoying Wei, Anqiang Pan
Pre-intercalated ions and octahedral defects alter the ligand field, leading to the elongation of V–O bonds and distortion on [VO6] octahedra, thereby lowering the 3d orbital energy level and stabilizing the energy efficiency.
